notes: entry_point is the single declared location for how the runner is invoked.
It is 'module' because the published gen-eval console script is broken upstream:
pyproject maps gen-eval to gen_eval.__main__:main, but main is async and takes
args, so the launcher raises TypeError. See UPSTREAM.md UP-1. Once UP-1 ships,
flip this to 'console-script' — that is the whole of task 7.3.
contract_version is this repository's pin on the gen-eval artifact contract.
Bump it whenever a regenerated schema changes shape, and record why in the
schemas_upstream_published stays false until UPSTREAM.md UP-2 lands and gen-eval
ships the schemas itself; until then they are generated here from runner_ref and
the generator is the source of truth for parity.
runner_source is a git ref only as an interim measure. Repointing it at an
artifact index is a change to this file alone.
